headline: Endava leverages AI agents to transform software delivery processes.

items.title: Endava Redesigns Software Delivery with AI Agents
items.summary: Endava is utilizing AI agents, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex, to streamline software delivery and automate workflows. This initiative aims to build an AI-native culture within the enterprise, enhancing productivity and reducing time-to-market for software products. The integration of these tools supports dynamic workflow management and real-time decision-making processes.
items.why_it_matters: AI agents can significantly boost development efficiency and innovation, crucial for tech leads aiming to maintain competitive advantage.

items.title: Introducing new capabilities to GPT-Rosalind
items.summary: GPT-Rosalind has been enhanced with advanced biological reasoning, medicinal chemistry expertise, genomics analysis, and experimental workflow capabilities. This upgrade aims to advance research in life sciences by providing more accurate and comprehensive analysis tools to scientists.

items.title: How Wasmer Used Codex for Node.js Runtime on the Edge
items.summary: Wasmer leveraged Codex and GPT-5.5 to develop a Node.js runtime for edge computing, significantly accelerating development time from months to weeks. This new runtime aims to enhance performance and scalability for edge computing applications.

items.title: Build Personal AI Agents on Windows PCs with Microsoft and NVIDIA
items.summary: Microsoft and NVIDIA have released new tools for constructing personal AI agents on Windows PCs. These tools are designed to enhance user interaction by integrating AI capabilities directly into desktop environments, enabling more personalized and efficient computing experiences.

items.title: Uber Caps Usage of AI Tools
items.summary: Uber has introduced a $1,500 monthly cap on AI tool usage, including tools like Claude Code, to manage operational costs. This move reflects a growing trend among companies to optimize AI tool expenditure while balancing innovation and cost-efficiency.

items.title: Toward Pre-Deployment Assurance for Enterprise AI Agents
items.summary: This research introduces a framework for pre-deployment verification of enterprise AI agents, addressing critical gaps between LLM capability benchmarking and production deployment. It emphasizes the importance of monitoring and human-in-the-loop controls for robust AI governance.
